description: Phase 1+2: applicable_when generation chain (backend Tasks 1-3) + frontend trimming + unified IPO utility (Tasks 4-9). Covers the full vertical slice from match_workpapers to GtWpRenderer overlay. Independent of FEAT-002/003 which only touch frontend component wiring and routing.
steps: 1. Read context.json first. Then read backend/app/services/wp_generation_matching.py in full. Add a 4th matching path after the 'conditional' elif block (~line 68). The new elif checks `m.get('applicable_when')` and iterates all dict keys using `_KEY_FLAG_PREFIX = {'business_category': 'biz_', 'industry': 'ind_'}`. Any matching key triggers hit=True (OR semantics between keys). See design §1.1 for exact code.

2. Read backend/app/services/chain_orchestrator.py lines 420-510 (the _step_generate_workpapers method). The SELECT (~line 435) currently fetches Project.template_type/report_scope/scenario/has_foreign_currency/audit_type/is_large_soe/wizard_state — add Project.business_category to this SELECT. After unpacking proj_row (~line 447), extract business_category and build biz_ flags: biz_ipo/biz_listed/biz_neeq/biz_refinancing using `'xxx' in biz_cat` substring matching. CONFIRMED: Project.industry does NOT exist in ORM (core.py grep returns 0) — so industry flags framework is declared but flags are always empty (design says this is acceptable). Add the project_flags.update() call with the 4 biz_ flags right after the existing project_flags dict construction (~line 490).

3. Add test cases in backend/tests/test_wp_account_mapping_single_source.py: (a) test_applicable_when_hit: a mapping with applicable_when={business_category:['ipo']}, project_flags={'biz_ipo':True} → matched; (b) test_applicable_when_miss: same mapping, project_flags={'biz_ipo':False} → not matched; (c) test_applicable_when_industry_key: a mapping with applicable_when={industry:['banking']}, project_flags={'ind_banking':True} → matched. Import match_workpapers from wp_generation_matching.

4. Create NEW file audit-platform/frontend/src/utils/ipoProjectUtils.ts with IPO_BIZ_KEYWORDS const array and isIpoProject(businessCategory, allowedCats?) function per design §1.4. Create test file audit-platform/frontend/src/utils/__tests__/ipoProjectUtils.spec.ts with vitest covering: keyword match, case-insensitive, empty string → false, allowedCats override.

5. Edit audit-platform/frontend/src/composables/useAProgramData.ts: (a) change applicableWhen ref type from `string | null` to `string | Record<string, string[]> | null`; (b) in the isNotApplicable computed, add a dict branch: if applicableWhen is an object with business_category array, call isIpoProject(projectStore.businessCategory, applicableWhen.business_category) and invert (not applicable if NOT ipo project). Import isIpoProject from @/utils/ipoProjectUtils.

6. BACKEND: In backend/app/services/wp_classification_service.py, add a new function `_load_applicable_when()` and module-level `_WP_APPLICABLE_WHEN` dict (parallel to existing `_WP_CODE_OVERRIDE`). This function reads backend/data/wp_account_mapping.json, extracts wp_code→applicable_when for non-None entries. CRITICAL: also aggregates bundle parent codes S32/S33/S34/S35 whose own applicable_when is None by taking the union of their children's business_category values (design §1.3.2 exact code). Add the 12 new s-checklist componentType strings to VALID_COMPONENT_TYPES set: 's1-regulation-record', 's8-adjudication', 's9-adjudication', 's9-internal-control', 's9-legal-regulations', 's9-program-description', 's10-adjudication', 's10-internal-control', 's10-environmental-regulations', 's17-nonrecurring-detail', 's17-reconciliation', 's17-tax-impact'.

7. BACKEND: In backend/app/routers/wp_render_config.py, import _WP_APPLICABLE_WHEN from wp_classification_service. In the get_render_config function, at the response construction point (~line 1043-1046), add `applicable_when` key to the response dict: `'applicable_when': _WP_APPLICABLE_WHEN.get(wp_code)` (None for most codes, dict for ~60 applicable codes).

8. FRONTEND: In audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/GtWpRenderer.vue, add a computed `isWpNotApplicable` that reads renderConfig.value?.applicable_when. If it's a dict with business_category array, use isIpoProject from @/utils/ipoProjectUtils against the project's business_category (from projectStore or renderConfig). If project doesn't match → true (not applicable). Add an el-result overlay in the template right after the redirect block (~line 33), guarded by v-else-if='isWpNotApplicable'. Chinese text: title='不适用', sub-title='当前项目类型不适用此底稿'. Import isIpoProject at the top of <script setup>.

9. FRONTEND Task 8: In audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/composables/useD4FormulaEngine.ts, (a) import isIpoProject from @/utils/ipoProjectUtils, (b) replace the isIpoGroupVisible function body to delegate: `return isIpoProject(businessCategory, [...IPO_BIZ_KEYWORDS, 'fraud_risk'])` where IPO_BIZ_KEYWORDS is imported from ipoProjectUtils. Keep the export name isIpoGroupVisible for backward compat (D4CrossSheet imports it). In useD4CrossSheet.ts: no change needed (it already imports isIpoGroupVisible from useD4FormulaEngine). In useF2SpecialFormData.ts: keep the existing isIpoProject computed as-is (it's the F2 wrapper with three-level cascade); add a comment noting it wraps @/utils/ipoProjectUtils for F2-specific multi-field fallback.

10. Run grep to confirm no other scattered IPO/business_category detection logic exists outside the ≤2 sources (ipoProjectUtils.ts core + useF2SpecialFormData.ts wrapper). If any found, note in findings.
acceptance_criteria: match_workpapers correctly matches applicable_when entries with OR semantics across dict keys (business_category, industry)
ipoProjectUtils.ts vitest passes with keyword matching, case insensitivity, and allowedCats
useAProgramData.ts isNotApplicable handles both string and dict applicable_when
GtWpRenderer.vue shows not-applicable overlay when render-config returns applicable_when that doesn't match project
render-config endpoint returns applicable_when field from _WP_APPLICABLE_WHEN
isIpoGroupVisible in useD4FormulaEngine delegates to isIpoProject (preserving fraud_risk keyword)
All 12 new componentType strings added to VALID_COMPONENT_TYPES in wp_classification_service.py
findings: 1. _WP_APPLICABLE_WHEN loaded 111 entries (direct + aggregated bundle parents S32/S33/S34/S35). 2. IPO detection converged to 2 definition sites: ipoProjectUtils.ts (core) + useF2SpecialFormData.ts (F2 wrapper). useD4FormulaEngine.isIpoGroupVisible now delegates to isIpoProject. 3. Pre-existing test failure test_codes_exist_in_real_account_chart (3 codes missing from PG account_chart) is NOT related to this change. 4. GtWpRenderer reads applicable_when from render-config response; project business_category read from renderConfig.project_context.business_category (injected by render strategies). 5. FEAT-002/003 should note: 12 new componentType strings added to VALID_COMPONENT_TYPES but NOT yet added to htmlRendererRegistry.ts type union or specialized.ts entries (that's FEAT-002's scope).
